en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a small, solid stone museum building with a steep tiled roof and decorative shields between large windows. Above the arched entrance is sculpted decoration and the word "JAHNMUSEUM". To the right stands a rough stone tower or wall remnant; to the left are trees and smaller town buildings. Printed captions at the bottom read "Freyburg a. U." on the left and "Jahnmuseum" on the right.
